## Documentation checklist

- [ ] Updated `docs/current-status.md` if the project state changed.
- [ ] Added a lab log entry if this includes meaningful progress.
- [ ] Added or updated an experiment note if this includes results.
- [ ] Added a decision record if this makes a non-obvious design choice.
- [ ] Updated setup instructions if dependencies, commands, or tools changed.
